description: This file provides utility functions for managing files and directories, including writing text files only if changed, removing files, and removing directories, primarily used in post-build scripts.

methods.name: writeTextFileIfChanged
methods.description: Writes the specified contents to a file only if the contents differ from the current file contents, creating necessary directories.

methods.name: removeFileIfExists
methods.description: Removes the specified file if it exists.

methods.name: removePathIfExists
methods.description: Removes the specified directory path and its contents if it exists.
